consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the February 11, 1986 show at the Henry J. Kaiser Convention Center was a fun and energetic performance, highlighted by strong jamming and the presence of the Neville Brothers. While some noted Jerry's vocal struggles, many praised the overall vibe and unique arrangements of the second set.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 32 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: The show had many high points and enjoyable moments, but also featured some vocal and performance inconsistencies that led to a more tempered overall reception.
